reviewed_by: Claude: spawn harness CLIs in their own process group under uvloop
reason: Backend-only fix in harnesses.py: the Codex app-server and Grok ACP spawns passed process_group=0, which uvloop (Core's loop) rejects before the child starts, so every Codex harness start failed. A new helper keeps process_group=0 on the stdlib loop and uses preexec_fn=os.setpgrp on uvloop, so the child still gets its own group in the worker's session and close still reaps its tree. Selected the new loop-parametrized spawn test, the process-tree reaping tests, and the Codex/Grok transport suites that spawn these CLIs.
exclusions: No UI, frontend, Playwright or native change. Full suites not run.
